title: Febrifuge
summary: FEB'RIFUGE, noun [Latin febris, fever, and fugo, to drive away.] Any medicine that mitigates or removes fever. FEB'RIFUGE, adjective Having the quality of mitigating or subduing fever; antifebrile.
